title: General Manager - Manufacturing & Operations
text:
General Manager – Manufacturing & Operations

**Wasatch Shutter & Design | West Jordan, UT**

**Job Type:** Full-Time, On-Site

**Pay:** $70,000–$80,000 per year, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonuses

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Wasatch Shutter & Design is looking for a motivated, hands-on leader to oversee our daily operations, manage our team, and help us become more efficient, productive, and profitable.

If you're currently an Operations Manager, Production Manager, Plant Manager, or experienced supervisor who is ready for more responsibility, this could be a great opportunity.

**You don't need to have been a General Manager before.** We're more interested in your leadership abilities, manufacturing experience, problem-solving skills, and ability to get results.

About Us

Wasatch Shutter & Design is an established Utah manufacturer and wholesale supplier of custom shutters and window coverings. We work with professional dealers throughout the region, providing quality products and dependable service.

We have an established team handling manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, sales, installation, and office operations. We're looking for someone who can bring these departments together, establish accountability, and keep the business running smoothly.

What You'll Do

**Lead Our Team**

* Manage daily operations across all departments.
* Establish clear expectations and hold employees accountable.
* Coach, train, and develop team members.
* Conduct regular meetings and monitor department performance.
* Resolve problems and keep employees focused on priorities.

**Improve Manufacturing & Efficiency**

* Oversee production schedules, workflow, and quality control.
* Implement lean manufacturing and continuous improvement practices.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve production efficiency.
* Reduce material waste, manufacturing errors, and remakes.
* Improve labor productivity and on-time delivery.

**Oversee Inventory & Purchasing**

* Ensure materials are available when needed.
* Oversee purchasing, inventory accuracy, and vendor coordination.
* Improve inventory controls and reduce unnecessary expenses.

**Manage Business Operations**

* Oversee office administration, scheduling, and installation coordination.
* Support B2B dealer relationships and customer service.
* Ensure customer concerns and operational problems are resolved.
* Monitor operating expenses, productivity, and key performance indicators.
* Work closely with ownership on business goals, financial performance, and growth opportunities.

What We're Looking For

* Experience leading employees in a manufacturing or operations environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Understanding of production scheduling, inventory, and purchasing.
* Experience improving processes and increasing productivity.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing or continuous improvement principles.
* Ability to manage multiple departments and priorities.
* Comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and taking initiative.
* Understanding of operating costs, budgets, and business performance.
* Comfortable working in both a manufacturing facility and an office environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Woodworking, cabinetry, millwork, building products, or custom manufacturing.
* Managing production teams or multiple departments.
* B2B sales, dealer relationships, or wholesale distribution.
* Implementing process improvements that reduced costs or increased efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results. Success in this position means:

* Production runs efficiently and jobs are completed on schedule.
* Employees understand their responsibilities and are accountable.
* Manufacturing mistakes, waste, and unnecessary expenses decrease.
* Inventory and purchasing are organized and controlled.
* Dealers receive reliable communication and excellent service.
* Departments work together effectively.
* The business continues improving its efficiency and profitability.

Why Join Wasatch Shutter & Design?

* Opportunity to advance into a General Manager position.
* Meaningful responsibility and decision-making authority.
* Work directly with ownership.
* Lead an established team rather than building one from scratch.
* Opportunity to implement improvements and see the results of your work.
* Established local manufacturing business with opportunities for professional growth.
* Performance-based bonus opportunities.

How to Apply

Submit your resume through Indeed.

**We'd also like to hear about a time you improved a process, increased productivity, reduced costs, or successfully led a team through a challenge.**

We're looking for someone who wants more than just a management title. We want a leader who takes pride in building a strong team, improving operations, and helping a business succeed.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
